The oscillator that shapes this lead is one you never hear.

In my Hitech FM presets for Vital, oscillator 2 sits at level zero and only frequency-modulates oscillator 1 (FM <- OSC 2). An envelope and your velocity set the FM depth, and velocity opens the filter too. Leads and basses are one voice, legato, with glide. The bass in the video, Rot Roller, drops oscillators 1 and 2 by two octaves and lets oscillator 2 modulate oscillator 3 as well.

32 presets: 12 leads, 8 basses, 6 plucks, 6 FX. Works with the free version of Vital (1.5.5 or newer). Link in bio.
